newsitem.headline: Systems Xcellence Q4 shr loss $0.48.

text.p: Three months ended Three months ended

NOTE: For the three months ended February 28, 1997, revenue from continuing operations was $3,064,849 and from discontinued operations $78,223, compared with $1,853,077 and $116,313, respectively, for the previous quarter in fiscal 1996.

The company's fiscal year 1997 revenue from continuing operations was $11,663,870 and from discontinued operations, $973,206. This compares with $8,734,354 and $125,110, respectively, for the previous fiscal year. iouive from discontinued operations). The company incurred a net loss from continuing operations of $7,472,779 or $0.82 cents per share and a loss from discontinued operations of $3,044,871 or $0.34 cents per share compared with a net loss from continuing operations of $3,199,833 or $0.43 cents per share and a loss from discontinued operations of $216,139 or $0.03 cents per share for the same period last year.
